intents_zh: RDS 用 API 拍快照
code:
import boto3, datetime
rds = boto3.client('rds')
snap_id = f"{{snapshot_prefix}}-" + datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')
resp = rds.create_db_snapshot(
    DBSnapshotIdentifier=snap_id,
    DBInstanceIdentifier='{{db_instance_id}}',
    Tags=[{'Key': 'auto', 'Value': 'true'}]
)
print('snapshot started:', resp['DBSnapshot']['DBSnapshotIdentifier'])
summary_zh: boto3 拍 RDS snapshot,id 帶 timestamp
